DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、暇？暇だよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんなに大したことじゃないんだけど、頼みたいことがあって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 忙しいなら大丈夫、大したことじゃないから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今、ちょっと忙しくって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もちろん平気だよ、暇人だから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……そうだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、分かった。邪魔してごめん

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや、そこまでは言ってないから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当に！そういう意味で言いたかったんじゃなくて！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 嘘、冗談だよ

DialogJP.Text: またそうやって私のことからかって！！！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もうほんと許さないんだから……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……とにかく、時間あるのよね？からかった罰でちゃんと付き合いなさい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 「カフェ・ミルフィーユ」に来て

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 他の子たちには内緒だからね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次は絶対私が奢るから！また連絡する！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前の約束、忘れたとは言わせないわよ。まだ借りが残ってるんだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先に言っとくけど、拒否権はないから。付き合ってくれるわよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……なんだか文字にすると変な感じになっちゃったけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 借りを返すって意味だから！それだけ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私としては他の意味でも大歓迎

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ちゃんと覚えてるよ。大丈夫、了解

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういう心臓に悪い冗談止めてくれる……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ待ってるから、遅れるんじゃないわよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もう何も言わないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 忘れて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 全部記憶から消して

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お尻の話とかしたら本気で殺すから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大したことじゃないんだけど、ちょっと手伝ってほしくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今度は何を食べに行くの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なんで食べる前提なの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私のこと豚か何かだと思ってる？口を開いたらどうせ餌だろうって？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 違うから！別の頼み事！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……ちゃんとした、先生だからこそお願いしたいことだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 冗談だよ、どこに行けばいい？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: またそうやって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……ありがと。場所は……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……その、これからもよろしく、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 授業出たくない……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ねえ先生、何か上手い感じにサボる方法とか無いの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっと……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それ、一応先生である私に聞く！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 分かってる、私も分かってるから。先生にこういうこと聞くのはおかしいって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ただ、今日は「カフェ・ミルフィーユ」の新作が出る日で……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 授業中にオープンしちゃうから……理由はただそれだけ。大したことじゃないから、気にしないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気持ちは分かるけど、とりあえず授業優先かな

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: OK、任せて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うっ、まあそりゃそうよね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 文脈理解してる……？まあいいや、仕方ない。ちゃんと授業には出るわよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、気が向いたらまた連絡するから(￣︶￣*)

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あー美味しかった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: やっぱりあそこのスイーツは外れが無い！あのとろける食感と、甘酸っぱい味……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生もああいうの、好き？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 違う、今のは無し、何も言わないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こういうのはダメ、そうじゃなくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、分かんないなら良いよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それじゃあまたね、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういえば

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: どこのカフェに行く？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 良いところでも見つかった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: え、何？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まだ何も言ってないんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや、まぁカフェにはいるけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いつも連絡くれる時はカフェにいるし

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今回もそうかなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まぁそうだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なんか、でも……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 決めつけられるのはイヤかも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まぁいいや、あとで送るから来てね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あーもう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: おっかしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: せっかくヨシミが買ってくれたのに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 一度くれたものを奪うなんて、鬼！悪魔！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うるさい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 自業自得でしょ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はぁ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 仕方ないわね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また買ってくるわよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次はちゃんと大事にしなさいよ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生♪

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐 꼭 그렇게 중요한 건 아니고! 그냥 부탁할 게 좀 있어서.

DialogKR.Text: 아무튼 고마워, 선생님. 어디로 오면 되는지 가르쳐 줄게

DialogKR.Text: 아 오늘은 진짜 수업 듣기 싫다……

DialogKR.Text: 어떻게 중간에 쨀 방법 없을까, 선생님?

DialogKR.Text: 그걸 또 선생님인 나에게 묻는 건가ㅋ

DialogKR.Text: 알아. 나도 안다고. 선생님한테 이런 말 하기 좀 그렇다는 거.

DialogKR.Text: 그냥 오늘이 카페 밀피유 이번 달 신상 공개 날인데……

DialogKR.Text: 공개 시간이 수업 중이라서 그랬어. 별 거 아냐. 신경 쓰지 마.

DialogKR.Text: 으응. 미안. 하긴 그 말이 맞지……

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um, Sensei? Are you free right now? You are, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have a small favor. It's nothing super important!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So it's okay if you're busy. It's nothing special.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I actually am a little busy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course I'm free. I'm just a benchwarmer, after all.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought you might be...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay. I won't bother you. Sorry.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What? That's not what I mean!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You know what I meant!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm just joking.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're making fun of me again.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll make you pay someday...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, so you can help me, right? You'd better make up for teasing me just now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll meet you at Cafe Mille-Feuille.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And don't tell anyone about this.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll call you again later. It'll be my treat!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you free right now, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You remember that we promised to meet, right? It's my treat this time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Let me just inform you right now that you have no choice but to say yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...Hmm, that sounded really awkward.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What I'm trying to say is, I want to pay off my debt! Settle what I owe you! Nothing else!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I wouldn't mind if it was something else.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I know. A promise is a promise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Can you please stop saying things like that? It really gets my heart going.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Good. I'll be waiting for you, so don't be late!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't tell anyone!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Absolutely no one!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And nuh uh, no BUTS!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: One word and you're dead!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you have time to spare, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's nothing serious, but I need some help.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What are we gonna eat this time?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do I look like a pig to you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you think all I do is eat all day?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No, not at all! I just need your help!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm asking you because you're my teacher.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm joking. Where do you want to meet?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You can't just say things like that and laugh it off...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, thanks. I'll tell you where to meet me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you so much for today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll give you a shout again, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I really don't wanna go to class today...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there any way for me to get out of this, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Today...? Is there something wrong?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Besides, you're asking me, your teacher? Haha

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I know, I know. I shouldn't say things like that to you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's just that Cafe Mille-Feuille is supposed to unveil their newest item today...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The reveal happens during class, but it's not a big deal. Don't worry about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Let's just focus on class for now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh, I see. I get you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, I'm sorry. You're right...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry about it, it's just my typical nonsense... Anyway, I got it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Talk to you later! //(￣︶￣*))

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That was the best!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Mille-Feuille never disappoints!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What did you think, Sensei? Did you like it? The Sunshine Mousse, I mean.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Never mind.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Wait, don't say anything. Not a word.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're probably gonna say something weird again and ruin the moment.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: See ya later, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Right, Sensei. I've been thinking about it...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Do you have a cafe you want to go to?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You find a good cafe?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I haven't even said anything yet.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean, it IS a cafe, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Haha

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Well, I guess it's always like this when we talk.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: AHHH!!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm pissed!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm so annoyed!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Haha

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hahahaha

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hahahahahahahahaha!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: To pretend to treat me...and then to eat it yourself...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: How could you?! You devil!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I don't wanna hear it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You had it coming.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll treat you again.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Try to actually get some next time, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Got it?

DialogTH.Text: พอดีอยากให้ช่วยอะไรหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: รอบนี้จะไปกินอะไรล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครูเห็นฉันเป็นหมูเหรอ???

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ทำไมต้องคิดว่าจะชวนไปกินอะไรอยู่
เรื่อยเลย??

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ใช่แบบนั้นสักหน่อย! แค่จะขอให้ช่วย
บางอย่างเท่านั้นเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: และที่มาขอ เพราะว่าเป็น 'คุณครู' ยังไงล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ล้อเล่นน่า จะให้ไปหาที่ไหนล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ทีหลังก็อย่าเอาเรื่องจริงมาพูดเล่นอีกล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ยังไงก็ขอบคุณนะ แล้วฉันจะบอกว่า
ให้ไปเจอที่ไหน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ฉันสนุกมากเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ต่อไปก็ฝากตัวด้วยนะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... วันนี้ไม่อยากเข้าเรียนเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่มีวิธีที่จะเลิกคลาสกลางคันเลยเหรอ
คุณครู?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้...? มีเรื่องอะไรงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมถามครูแบบนั้นล่ะ ครูเป็นครูนะ? หึหึ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
รู้อยู่แล้วน่า... ฉันรู้แล้วล่ะ พูดแบบนี้
กับคุณครูก็คงดูไม่ดีเท่าไหร่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็แค่วันนี้เป็นวันเปิดตัวสินค้าใหม่ประจำ
เดือนของคาเฟ่มิลเฟย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เวลาเปิดตัวมันเป็นเวลาเรียนพอดีน่ะ...
ไม่ใช่เรื่องใหญ่หรอก ไม่ต้องใส่ใจก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นก็เรียนก่อนก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... เข้าใจแล้ว เข้าใจแล้วล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ขอโทษนะ นั่นสิ... ก็คงแบบนั้นล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พูดอะไรไม่รู้เรื่องเลย... เอาเป็นว่า
เข้าใจแล้วล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้จะติดต่อไปใหม่นะ~ //(￣︶￣*))

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า.... สุดยอดจริงๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
สุดยอด ไม่ทำให้ผิดหวังเลยจริงๆ
มิลเฟยเนี่ย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูว่าเป็นไงมั่ง? โอเครึเปล่า?
ซันไชน์มูส~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เปล่าหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่... ไม่ต้องพูดอะไร ไม่ต้องพูด...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เดี๋ยวพูดอะไรไม่เป็นเรื่องแล้วจะทำให้
เรื่องมันยุ่งยากขึ้นกว่าเดิม...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นไว้เจอกันนะ คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จริงด้วยคุณครู พอมาลองนึกๆ
ดูแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เราจะไปคาเฟ่ไหนดีล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เจอร้านดีๆ บ้างมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยังไม่ได้พูดอะไรเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่สิ ก็ใช่คาเฟ่อยู่หรอก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: คิกๆ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ก็นะ เวลาติดต่อมา ก็มักจะเป็นตอน
แบบนั้นตลอดนี่นา...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊าาาาา!!!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: น่าโมโหที่สุด

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: น่าหงุดหงิดจริงๆ...!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮะฮ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่าฮ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮ่าฮ่าฮ่าฮ่าๆๆๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
มีที่ไหนกันที่ซื้อให้ แล้วก็มาแย่งไป
แบบนี้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ซื้อให้แล้วมาแย่งไปแบบนี้ มีใครที่ไหน
เขาทำกัน?! ปีศาจชัดๆ!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หนวกหูน่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: กรรมตามสนองแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วก็

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอาไว้จะซื้อให้ใหม่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนั้นก็เก็บเอาไว้ให้ดีๆ ล่ะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจมั้ย?

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，有空嗎？你很閒對吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然沒有很重要，但有件事想要拜託你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果在忙的話也沒關係，畢竟不是什麼重要的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 當然沒問題，反正我很閒嘛

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，我知道了。抱歉打擾你了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真的！我真的沒有那個意思！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……總之，你有空對吧？作為捉弄我的懲罰，請好好陪我一下吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次我一定會請客的！之後再聯絡！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前約好的，我可不准你說忘記了喔。我還有欠你的還沒還呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 先告訴你，你可沒有拒絕的權利。你會來陪我吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……總覺得用打字的話好像變得有點奇怪

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是要還你人情的意思！就是這樣而已！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 有其他意思我也很歡迎喔

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 當然記得囉。沒問題，了解

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 能停止那種對心臟不好的玩笑嗎……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 讓它們全都從記憶中消失

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果講什麼屁股之類的話，我真的會殺了你喔

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然不是很重要，但有件事想請你幫忙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你把我當成是豬還是什麼了嗎？只要開口就是要吃飼料嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 才不是咧！是要拜託你其他的事！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……是正經的，因為你是老師才想拜託你的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 開玩笑的，那我該去哪呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘿，老師，有什麼偷懶的好方法嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我知道，我知道啦。問老師這種事情很奇怪

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但是，今天是「Café．Mille-feuille」推出新品的日子……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為會在上課時開始販售……理由只是這樣。沒什麼大不了的，別放在心上

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我懂你的心情，但還是以上課為優先吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有理解上下文嗎……？算了，這也沒辦法。我會好好去上課的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text:
那就先這樣，想連絡的時候會再聯絡你
(￣︶￣*)

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 果然那裡的甜點從來不會讓人失望！那融化的口感和酸甜的味道……！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒事，當我沒說，你什麼都別說

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔，雖然的確是咖啡廳沒錯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 畢竟你聯絡我的時候幾乎都是這樣……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 居然把買給人家的東西搶回去吃

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 哪有先給別人又搶回去的！？惡魔！！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到時候老師可要看好它哦
